subject: QBR triage: forecast sanity checks & account-level notes
body:
--- Message 1/6 ---
From: Ellie Shaw <ellie@orchardanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Attaching our updated forecast (orchard_forecast_v2.xlsx) — the sales ops team trued up bookings by ARR bucket and moved two opportunities into 'late stage' after the June PoC completed. High-level changes:
- ACME Health: +$120k ARR (contracting)
- Verde Systems: -$40k ARR (procurement delay)
- Longtail: net +$18k ARR across micro-licenses

Can you confirm the Redwood account owners will provide one-page summaries for each named account (ask, risk, next milestone) by EOD Mon (6/20)? We'll highlight those in our QBR.

Thanks,

Ellie Shaw
Director, Revenue
Orchard Analytics

Attachment: orchard_forecast_v2.xlsx (excel, 64KB)

--- Message 2/6 ---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:13:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

Team — looping in account owners and ops. Ellie sent an updated forecast and asked for concise one-pagers by EOD Mon 6/20. Ask below:

1) Account one-pager: current ARR, ask (what we need from prospect), biggest risk, next milestone/date, required Redwood owner action (1-2 bullets).
2) If you have adjusted forecast numbers (up or down), add a short rationale and link to any supporting artifacts (SOW draft, procurement PR, PO emails).

Marissa / Ben: can you split the account list? Marissa — take ACME Health, Verde Systems, Longtail; Ben — cover the remaining Orchard-linked targets (list in the drive link). Rishi: please sanity-check the new ACME uplift before we include it in the consolidated forecast.

Deliverables:
- account-onepagers.zip (zip containing individual PDFs)
- consolidated forecast table (single sheet in the drive)

I'll assemble the QBR slide insert. If anyone expects pushback on the ACME uplift, flag it in-line.

Thanks — Neha

Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3/6 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

Neha — uploaded one-pagers to the drive (see link). Quick notes on the three Orchard accounts you assigned:

ACME Health: owner: Marissa Cole
- Current ARR: $320k
- Ask: expedite final legal review + signature of enterprise SOW (expected $120k uplift)
- Risk: 3rd-party security sign-off delayed (vendor questionnaire outstanding)
- Next milestone: Legal signoff targeted 6/28
- Support needed: Rishi to confirm uplift (see 'ACME-support.pdf' in attachments)

Verde Systems:
- Current ARR: $90k
- Ask: procurement budget approval — procurement to finalize by 7/6
- Risk: single procurement approver on vacation through 6/24

Longtail (micro-license consolidation):
- Current ARR: $52k
- Ask: scale pilot to full rollout; finance PO expected late June

Attachments: account-onepagers.zip (contains ACME-onepager.pdf, Verde-onepager.pdf, Longtail-onepager.pdf), ACME-support.pdf (email excerpts)

--- Message 4/6 ---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:22:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. I reviewed ACME-support.pdf and have a couple of notes:
- The $120k uplift assumes conversion of a pilot into enterprise; current usage metrics show strong trend but we lack the signed SOW. I'd prefer marking the uplift as 'pending' and including a confidence bracket (60%).
- Suggest we add a single-slide backup that lists the 3 key dependencies (security questionnaire completion, SOW signature, procurement timeline). That will help the exec readout.

I'll mark the consolidated forecast with a confidence column and send the version to Neha by EOD Sun (6/20).

-Rishi

--- Message 5/6 ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

Team — small calendar note: our QBR readout to execs is scheduled for Wed 6/23. Neha, if you can get the consolidated forecast and the one-pagers into the shared QBR deck by EOD Tue (6/22) I'll take a pass on the narrative and exec bullets. A couple of asks:
- Keep the ACME uplift but show it as 'scenario A' (60% confidence) and include the backup slide Rishi suggested.
- Add a single-slide 'ask & runway' appendix for any accounts with >$50k delta since last QBR.

I'll be out Tue morning but will review in the afternoon. Thanks.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 6/6 ---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated QBR numbers + ask for account notes

All — thanks for the inputs. Action summary:
- Marissa: final ACME one-pager updated and ACME-support.pdf annotated (received).
- Rishi: please drop the consolidated forecast with confidence % into the drive by 5pm PT Tue (6/22).
- Ben: please compile the one-pagers into the QBR deck template and add the appendix slides for >$50k deltas.
- Laura: will review the assembled deck Wed afternoon then finalize exec bullets.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprep-ORCHARD
- Consolidated forecast (sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1consolidated-forecast

I'll notify Ellie and Orchard that we're including scenario A for visibility once Laura signs off.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: orchard_forecast_v2.xlsx, account-onepagers.zip, ACME-support.pdf, qbr-deck-template-v3.pptx
